item.title: La France ouvre la porte au FSD de Tesla malgré son refus de juillet avec deux voitures fournies par Elon Musk
item.description: Philippe Tabarot a passé une visio avec Elon Musk. Six semaines après avoir jugé le FSD pas assez sûr, la France lance des essais sur route, à un mois d'un vote européen qui pourrait tout débloquer.

item.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
item.description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.

item.title: UN report says global warming will surpass the goal of 1.5 degrees Celsius
item.description: Climate scientists now aim to minimize time spent above the limit from the Paris Agreement.

item.title: MapQuest is now the No. 1 U.S. app after bucking Trump’s ‘Lake America’ renaming
item.description: The once-dominant mapping app has surged to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store after refusing to adopt Trump’s “Lake America” name, drawing more than half of its 2026 U.S. downloads in just six days.

item.title: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
item.description: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash, arriving just a few weeks after its predecessor. The company claims the new model "works harder" than Gemini 3.7 Flash by performing more reasoning steps on complex tasks and "calling tools iteratively." It has the same introductory pricing as 3.7 Flash, $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million […]

item.title: AI is getting closer to being able to exploit OT, and that's very bad news for critical infrastructure
item.description: The situation is not disastrous just yet, but it's definitely time to start paying attention, Forescout hints.

item.title: Hyundai just topped the world’s largest EV battery study — analysis of 500,000 tests sees it beat Tesla to the long-term battery health title
item.description: 500,000 EV battery tests reveal the electric cars that hold onto their range best.

item.title: It sure looks like hackers breached a major ID card verification service
item.description: An identity theft search site claimed to have more than 150 million driver's license photos stolen from an ID verification service. The crime site has now shut down.

item.title: Delivery Hero board backs Uber’s $15B takeover bid
item.description: If approved, the combined company would become one of the largest food delivery platforms in the world.

item.title: Lockheed carries out missile launches directly from a drone boat - will the US Navy be next?
item.description: A crewless sailboat fired two live missiles at RIMPAC, six months after Lockheed and Saildrone started work. The boat sails itself, but a Navy-operated fire control system still makes weapon-deployment decisions.

item.title: « Ouvrir la porte et se retrouver devant le vide » : Sophie Adenot répond aux questions après ses trois sorties dans l’espace
item.description: L'astronaute française Sophie Adenot a accordé quelques dizaines de minutes aux journalistes pour une conférence de presse en direct depuis la Station spatiale internationale. L'occasion de faire un bilan alors que le retour sur Terre approche.
